authority: This file is the ONLY place task status lives. BUILD-TRACKER.md defines tasks; it never records status.

status_values.todo: Not started. Eligible for selection when every `needs` id is `done`.
status_values.in_progress: Claimed by the current session. Only one task may hold this at a time.
status_values.done: Completed and verified. Its Verify commands passed.
status_values.blocked: Cannot be completed as written. `blocked_reason` is filled and the id is listed in `blocked_on`.
status_values.awaiting_human: Work an AI may not complete. Only a human may move this to `done`. Treated as NOT satisfying a dependency.
status_values.superseded: Replaced by a later task id. Never selected. Its output is not edited.

read_order_for_ai: 1. Read THIS file only (~10KB). Do not open ARCHITECTURE.md yet.
2. Check blocked_on. If non-empty, STOP and report to the user.
2b. Check `phase_gates`. If a gate's condition is not met, no task it guards may be selected, even if its `needs` are all done.

3. Find the first task in `tasks` with status 'todo' whose every `needs` id has status 'done'. That is the ONLY task for this session. A need with status 'awaiting_human', 'blocked' or 'superseded' does NOT count as satisfied. If no task qualifies and at least one task is 'awaiting_human', STOP and report: 'Build is waiting on human sign-off for <ids>. A human must set these to done in build-state.json before work continues.'
4. Open BUILD-TRACKER.md and read ONLY that task's card (search for its id).
5. Open ARCHITECTURE.md and read ONLY the sections listed in the card's `Load` line. Nothing else.
6. Build exactly the card's Do list. Touch only the card's Files.
7. Run the card's Verify commands. All must pass.
8. Update this file: set that task to 'done', append a session_log entry, bump updated_at.
9. STOP. Do not begin the next task, even if it looks trivial.
global_rules: ONE task per session. Never chain tasks.

Never revise a 'done' task's work. If a done task's output is wrong, add a new task with a new id and set the old one's status to 'superseded'. Additively extending a shared file (adding a script to package.json, adding a job to ci.yml, appending a section to docs/RUNBOOK.md) is NOT a revision and is allowed when that path appears in the current card's Files list.
Never invent facts about the school. See ARCHITECTURE.md A-3.1. Use the literal marker [[CONTENT REQUIRED — DO NOT PUBLISH]].
If a task cannot be completed as written, set status 'blocked', fill blocked_reason, add to blocked_on, and STOP.
If the work would need files outside the card's Files list, STOP and report scope drift instead of expanding.
Every completed task = one commit, message 'T-0XX: <title>'.
PRODUCT-SPEC.md assumes every decision in ARCHITECTURE.md Parts A/B. If a task's Load line names both and they disagree, ARCHITECTURE.md wins.

build-state.json `needs` is the only authoritative dependency graph. A card's `Needs` and `Unlocks` lines are a human-readable mirror; if they disagree with the JSON, the JSON wins and the card must be corrected.

M8_before_launch.rule: No task in M9 or M10 may be selected until every M8 task is done.

content_gate.rule: T-130 requires the ARCHITECTURE.md A-3.1 checklist signed off by the school. Placeholders must not reach production, which is what T-113's placeholder gate enforces.

human_gates.rule: T-131 is human-only. An AI sets it to 'awaiting_human' and never to 'done'. Only a human may set it to 'done', and that is what unblocks T-132.

CI skeleton. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the A-14.2 stages this card owns and no more: a `verify` job (checkout, setup-node 24 with npm cache, npm ci, prisma generate, lint, typecheck, build, unit tests, dependency audit) and a parallel `secret-scan` job running gitleaks over full history (fetch-depth 0, since a secret committed and later removed is still leaked). permissions: contents: read, and a concurrency group that cancels superseded runs. Triggers on pull_request and on push to main; the deploy half of A-14.2 (staging, approval, prod, tag) is T-123 and the budgets are T-114, so neither appears. .github/dependabot.yml watches npm and github-actions weekly, grouping minor+patch into one PR while leaving majors separate so React/Next/Prisma upgrades each get their own review. vitest.config.ts: node environment (everything tested through M8 is server-side), include globs over src/ and tests/, tests/e2e/ excluded because those specs are Playwright's in T-112, and the @/ alias mirrored from tsconfig. Three judgement calls. First, package.json and package-lock.json are outside the card's Files list but had to change - 'Vitest configured' is unsatisfiable without installing the runner - so vitest 4.1.10 was added and pinned exactly to match the project's no-caret convention, plus `test` (vitest run --passWithNoTests, the card's 'empty suite OK') and `test:watch`. Same precedent as T-003 adding zod. Second, the audit gate blocks at `critical`, not `high`: three high advisories exist today (postcss and sharp, both transitive through next 15.5.23) whose only npm-offered remedy is next@16, a breaking major that would revise the done T-001. Blocking at high would make the pipeline red on its first run and contradict the card's Stop line, so highs are emitted as a ::warning:: annotation and stay visible while Dependabot carries the upgrade. Third, gitleaks runs via the official gitleaks-action@v2, which is free for personal accounts and public repositories but needs a GITLEAKS_LICENSE secret under an organisation. Verified locally in CI's exact order against a wiped node_modules: npm ci clean from the lockfile, prisma generate, eslint, tsc --noEmit, next build, vitest, and the audit gate all exit 0; both YAML files parse.
